nodes.label: API Gateway / BFF (Kong + GraphQL)
nodes.rationale: Stateless edge: TLS termination, routing, JWT validation, rate limiting, quota pre-checks, presigned upload brokering, GraphQL schema stitching, response caching. Owns no domain data. Scales horizontally behind LB.

nodes.label: Auth & User Service (JWT/OAuth)
nodes.rationale: Source of truth for identity, accounts, sessions, JWKS, plan flags. Stateless, always-on, cheap-to-scale tier.

nodes.label: Media Ingestion (Upload Brokering)
nodes.rationale: Presigned direct-to-storage uploads, type/size validation, malware/NSFW scanning, resumable chunking. Media bypasses gateway entirely. Appless and in-app uploaders check quota before accepting.
